themes.title: Themes
themes.intro: Themes are visual identity (type, color, spacing). Pick a site layout separately under Patterns.
themes.invalid: This theme cannot be activated. Check its theme.json, parent theme and index.html.
templates.title: Template files — advanced
templates.intro: Templates of %s. Overrides are stored in the data directory and win over the theme files.
templates.name: Template
editor.title: Edit %s
editor.saved_draft: Draft saved. It is visible only in preview.
editor.deleted: Override deleted; the theme file is used again
editor.invalid: The template could not be saved
editor.draft_notice: You are editing an unpublished draft. Visitors still see the published version.
editor.help: Go html/template syntax. Use part "header" and component "card" to include theme pieces.
editor.not_found: There is no override for this template.
settings.title: Theme settings
settings.intro: Options for the active theme, %s. Theme-specific values can override shared site identity settings.
settings.none: The active theme has no settings.
overview.title: Site overview
overview.intro: Browse public pages in isolated, read-only previews. Open a page separately to interact with it.
overview.no_tokens: The theme defines no CSS variables in :root.
overview.print_timeout: Some previews are still loading. Wait a moment, then try printing again.
overview.print_incomplete: Some previews are not ready. Use the Print button in Site overview to load all previews before printing.
overview.print_pending: Preview not yet loaded. Open the page using its link:
overview.more: and %d more pages in the sitemap
overview.contrast_note: WCAG 2: normal text needs 4.5:1, large text 3:1. Roles are inferred from the theme's variable names.
overview.no_pairs: The theme does not name its text and background colors in a known way.
overview.body_sample: Sample text showing paragraphs on the site at reading size and the theme's line spacing, with
overview.muted_sample: Muted text for dates and side notes.
overview.notice_sample: Notice: important messages look like this.
overview.card_text: A short description in muted text.
overview.inferred_note: These samples are inferred from CSS variables, not measured from the rendered page. Selector overrides may differ. Use the page previews to inspect the current design.
identity.error_color: Use a hex color such as #1f6feb.
identity.error_css: Custom CSS cannot contain HTML tags, @import, expression() or javascript: URLs.
identity.error_css_size: Custom CSS is limited to 20000 characters.
settings.source_default: No theme customization: shared identity or theme defaults apply.
settings.reset_pending: The inherited default will apply after saving.
overview.search_previews: Search the previews shown on this page
identity.title: Identity
identity.intro: Logos, name, colours, fonts, shape and spacing for the whole site. Changes go to a draft you can preview; Apply makes them live and keeps the previous identity so you can go back.
identity.unsupported: The active theme "%s" does not accept identity settings (its theme.json does not declare "identity"). Logos, name and tagline still apply; colours and fonts stay as the theme designed them.
identity.logo_primary_help: Shown in the header and wherever the theme prints the site mark.
identity.logo_light_help: Optional; falls back to the main logo.
identity.logo_dark_help: Optional; used in dark scheme and dark footers.
identity.logo_icon_help: Square mark for favicons and compact headers.
identity.name: Site name
identity.contrast_fail: below WCAG AA (4.5:1); choose a darker text or lighter background
identity.contrast_none: Set both colours to check contrast.
identity.preview_help: Renders your real site with the draft. Nothing is published until you apply.
identity.draft_pending: You have an unapplied draft (saved %s). The preview shows it; the live site still uses the applied identity.
identity.history_help: Applying keeps the last %d identities. Reverting restores colours, fonts, logos, name and tagline only; pages and posts are untouched.
identity.history_none: No identity has been applied yet.
identity.history_invalid: The stored history could not be read; applying starts a new one.
identity.import_help: The site builder saved colours and a font. Copy them into the draft to review here; the builder values stay as a fallback layer.
identity.error_invalid: Some values are not valid. Check the marked fields.
identity.error_failed: The identity could not be saved. Try again.
identity.error_tagline: Tagline must be at most 500 characters
identity.error_text_contrast: Text and background need at least 4.5:1 contrast
identity.notice_draft: Draft saved. The preview shows it.
identity.notice_imported: Builder identity copied into the draft.
identity.error_option: Choose one of the offered options
identity.error_url: Use an internal path such as /contact or a full http(s) URL
identity.error_theme_changed: The active theme changed since this page was opened. Nothing was saved; reload the page to edit the identity of the current theme.
identity.draft_rebased: The live site changed these values after the draft was saved; the draft now uses the live values: %s.
